buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. Nature and Scope of Procurement The Buyer intends to procure the nine miscellaneous campus services listed below on an as-and-when-required, item-wise unit-rate basis. This is not a fixed monthly manpower e ngagement. No minimum quantity, fixed monthly payment or guaranteed work value is assured. Each assi gnment requires an authorised written work order specifying the service, quantity, location and required c ompletion period. 2. Schedule of Services and Quote Units S. No. Service Quote unit 1 Septic tank cleaning / desludging Per tank / job 2 Supply of water through tanker Per tanker trip 3 Unskilled labour for cleaning / housekeeping Per person-day (8 hours) 4 Tractor trolley for soil / earth transportation Per trolley trip 5 JCB machine with operator Per machine-hour 6 Grass cutting / brush clearing Per square metre 7 Bedsheet was hing Per piece 8 Blanket washing Per piece 9 Pillow cover washing Per piece 3. Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting - 30 October 2026 Pre-Bid Meeting Date: 30 October 2026. Participation in the Pre-Bid Meeting shall be man datory for all prospective bidders, subject to this requirement being approved and expressly incorporated i n the published GeM bid. The venue, reporting time and designated officer shall be communicated through the bid / official corrigendum. A bidder may attend through its authorised representative, carrying a signe d authorisation letter and identity proof. Mandatory submission of document copies: At the Pre-Bid Meeting , every prospective bidder must submit a complete, legible set of copies of all documents that the bidder p roposes to upload or is required to upload in the GeM bid, including supporting registrations, declarations, eligibility / experience evidence and any other bid-specific documents, as applicable. Each copy shall be du ly signed and stamped / self-attested by the bidder or authorised signatory. The copies submitted at Pre-Bi d shall correspond to the documents subsequently uploaded in the GeM technical bid; any subsequent cha nge shall be explained and supported as permitted by GeM rules. The Buyer may maintain an attendance register and acknowledge receipt of the document set. Mere attendance or submission of copies does not e stablish technical qualification. Any bid rejection on the grounds of non-attendance or non-submission mus t be permissible under prevailing GeM rules and expressly provided for in the approved published bid. Fina ncial bids / quoted prices must not be submitted or disclosed at the Pre-Bid Meeting. 4. Price and Bid Subm ission Bidders shall quote unconditional, all-inclusive item-wise unit rates only in the designated GeM finan cial bid fields. Rates shall cover applicable labour, vehicles / equipment, operators, fuel, tools, PPE, mobilis ation, transportation, loading / unloading, safe and lawful disposal and incidental costs. GST shall follow th e published bid settings. Prices must not be shown in the technical documents. No extra payment is admiss ible unless specifically provided for in the published bid and authorised work order. 5. Eligibility / Pre-Qualif ication and Documents EMRS Panchagurha | GeM Custom Bid ATC | 30 Oct 2026 Pre-Bid Page 2 The bidder must be a legally recognised entity eligible to transact on GeM. PAN, GST registration or legally applicable exemption / declaration, non-debarment declaration and bid-specific credentials must be submitted as req uired. For regulated jobs, valid licences, permits and authorisations shall be produced before work begins. Any minimum experience / turnover conditions and permitted MSE / startup exemptions must match the a pproved published bid and applicable GeM norms. 6. Scope of Execution and Safety Services shall be exec uted only at the designated EMRS campus areas on written call-off. The contractor shall provide trained w orkers, suitable machinery and vehicles, supervisors as required, PPE and compliance with labour, occupat ional safety, environmental, transport and local regulations. Hazardous manual cleaning or unsafe confine d-space entry for septic tank work is prohibited; only lawful mechanised cleaning and authorised disposal s hall be used. Campus property and cleanliness shall be protected. Work orders shall specify tanker capacit y and quality; trolley capacity / route; JCB machine-hour basis; grass clearance area and debris disposal sit e; and laundry item counts, washing, drying, folding and return. Service-specific dimensions, mobilisation a rrangements and technical requirements shall be recorded in the order. 7. Measurement, Inspection and A cceptance Actual quantities shall be jointly measured for each applicable unit (tank/job, trip, person-day, machine-hour, square metre or laundry piece). Signed service-completion / measurement records, attenda nce or trip/hour logs, and laundry issue / return registers shall substantiate service acceptance. Defective or incomplete work may be rectified or rejected under the approved contract conditions. 8. Payment Term s Payment is admissible only for duly ordered, satisfactorily performed, verified and accepted services. Th e contractor shall provide a compliant invoice referencing the work order, service / item, accepted quantit y and applicable unit rate along with signed completion records. Payments will follow the applicable GeM a nd Buyer financial workflow, within the contractually prescribed timelines. No advance payment unless exp ressly permitted in the published contract. 9. Service Levels, Penalty and Remedies Mobilisation time, com pletion time, service quality standards, liquidated damages / penalties, computation and caps (if any) shall be defined in the approved bid / work order in accordance with GeM terms. Penalties shall not be imp osed arbitrarily or retrospectively. Before disputed deductions, the contractor shall receive appropriate not ice and opportunity to respond. 10. Contract Administration and Compliance Only authorised written work orders shall bind the Buyer. The contractor shall nominate a site coordinator. Subcontracting and dispute r esolution shall follow the GeM contract. Contract period, indicative quantities / weightages, financial evalu ation methodology, estimated value, GAR, competent-authority undertaking and any mandatory requireme nts must be verified by the Buyer before publication. The above Pre-Bid condition must also be checked fo r compatibility with the applicable GeM category and procurement rules .
